features.name: Whispers of the Dead
features.desc: After each rest, you gain proficiency in one skill or tool of your choice (it changes when you use this again).

features.name: Wails from the Grave
features.desc: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you deal Necrotic damage to a second creature within 30 feet equal to half your Sneak Attack dice. Number of uses equals your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Tokens of the Departed
features.desc: When someone nearby dies, you can use your Reaction to create a trinket (up to your Proficiency Bonus): it grants Advantage on Death Saving Throws and Constitution saving throws, fuels Wails from the Grave, or lets you ask a spirit a question.

features.name: Ghost Walk
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you take on a ghostly form for 10 minutes: Fly Speed 10 feet, attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and you can move through creatures and objects.

features.name: Death's Friend
features.desc: Wails from the Grave now deals damage to both the first and the second target; at the end of a Long Rest, you gain a trinket if you have none left.
